propositions: Without a git-remote-s3 helper (>=0.3.2) on PATH, using an s3:// or s3+zip:// ticket-store remote causes silent store corruption (duplicate bundles for one ref); currently nothing prevents this misconfiguration from being driven.

A preflight check must detect S3 mode by remote URL scheme and raise OptionalDependencyError unconditionally if the helper is missing or too old, overriding best-effort delivery to fail closed early with an actionable message.
The S3 preflight must guard all write/push paths: init/mount time, synchronous always push, and async push parent process; reusing existing URL resolutions to avoid redundant git shell-outs.
Non-S3 remotes (file://, GitHub-style) must be unaffected and the preflight must be a no-op for them; unresolvable remotes must keep existing best-effort skipping and not be misread as S3 mode.

OptionalDependencyError from the S3 preflight must propagate through uncaught write_and_push calls and be re-raised in push_after_commit's exception handler to prevent swallowing the misconfiguration halt.
S3 mode detection uses only the existing sync.remote config field and URL scheme matching; no new config key or schema migration is needed.
